page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top: a running title line in capitals above the title block. Centre: the title block in large type, with a short line of text beneath it. Lower centre: a woodcut or engraved device. Bottom: the printer's imprint in capitals, two lines.
page.l: Dicta in Templo Ryswiek, in exercitiis Theologicis,
a. d. XVIII. Novemb. CIↄ Iↄ C LXXXIII.
page.notes: The title block is printed upside down and in mirror image at the top; the lines above are transcribed as they read in the sense of the title. The lower block reads "Trajecti ad Rhenum, apud Gulielmum vander Lacr(?), Bibliopolam, Anno MDCLXXXIII" as far as legible. The central woodcut device is undescribed. Several words in the title block are faint and uncertain, marked by reading only. Ink show-through from the reverse is present throughout.
